name: Compact / Suppressed pistol

request.text: Exactly one suppressed pistol shot, isolated close microphone recording for a video game. A tight low pressure pop with a crisp sliding metal action and restrained punch, realistic rather than a laser or cartoon silencer. Shot immediately at the start, short clean decay. Dry studio sound, no music, no voice, no ambience, no echo, no additional shots.
